title: HILLS BANCORPORATION 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Hills Bancorporation, a small Iowa-based bank holding company, filed a Form 8-K disclosing the results of its April 20, 2026 annual shareholder meeting. Shareholders elected four directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified the appointment of Crowe, LLP as the independent auditor.
key_points: Hills Bancorporation held its annual shareholder meeting on April 20, 2026
Four directors elected: Emily A. Hughes, James C. Schmitt, Lisa A. Shileny, and Roger K. Smith (to serve until 2029)
Executive compensation advisory vote passed with 4,212,525.84 votes for against 104,478.06 against
Crowe, LLP ratified as independent auditor with 4,791,054.10 votes for against 42,106.52 against
Lisa A. Shileny signed as Director, President and CEO
